notes: tpurtell 0.9.1 with v0.7.0's parallel layout: ENABLE_EXPERT_PARALLEL=1 (EP2 routed experts) and DECODE_CONTEXT_PARALLEL_SIZE=2, with which the launcher sets VLLM_GLM53_MLA_OWNERS=tp (no MLA layer ownership), VLLM_GLM53_NOPE_RECORD=0 (656-byte records) and VLLM_GLM53_DRAFT_SLOT_SHARING=0 (separate draft pages); and VLLM_B12X_DCP_TOPK_OWNER_EXCHANGE=0, because the default PCIe owner exchange fails on this B12x fork, so the top-k merge gathers every rank's candidates instead. Same selection rule, different transport; a deviation from v0.7.0's exact configuration, as in the layout bisection's arm D (k3.25-v0.9.0-ep2dcp2-dflash3). Otherwise as 0.9.1 ships: DFlash2 x3, vision off. Prefix caching off, so prompt log-probabilities score every position.
